purpose: Manual-review queue for the ten remaining VirgoStars backend star labels that cannot be safely assigned one-to-one HIP aliases without historical-name/component review. Suggestions are non-authoritative until accepted.
sourceNote: Official IAU catalog/current IAU mirror, SIMBAD object records and historical nomenclature contextual references. No proprietary Swiss fixed-star numeric data.

names.name: Alsuhail
names.reason: Historical Alsuhail spelling likely refers to Lambda Velorum, whose official IAU name is Suhail; alias must be confirmed against the actual backend expectation.

names.name: Foramen
names.reason: Historical name for Eta Carinae: extremely variable interacting binary with unusual extended ejecta; no source-vetted HIP I/311 record established. Do not fabricate 6D Hipparcos values.

names.name: Gienah cygni
names.reason: The name Gienah was formerly shared by Epsilon Cygni and Gamma Corvi; IAU names Epsilon Cygni Aljanah. Review the backend's intended component and name normalization.

names.name: Gienah Ghurab
names.reason: Legacy descriptive label distinguishes Gamma Corvi from Epsilon Cygni; official IAU Gienah applies to Gamma Corvi. Resolve semantics before adding aliases.

names.name: Han
names.reason: Historical Han/Khan label attached to Zeta Ophiuchi; not a unique current IAU name in the source snapshot. Verify object identity and terminology.

names.name: Metallach
names.reason: Legacy Metallach/Metallah spelling for Alpha Trianguli (Mothallah); this is a variable binary, and aliases require explicit review.

names.name: Ras Alhague
names.reason: Historical spelling variant of IAU Rasalhague on Alpha Ophiuchi; record whether the backend expects the primary or system.

names.name: Rigil
names.reason: Historical name for Alpha Centauri can mean the whole system; official Rigil Kentaurus is Alpha Cen A, while Toliman is B; component motion and magnitudes differ.

names.name: Shedir
names.reason: Historical spelling of IAU Schedar for Alpha Cassiopeiae. Validate casing/legacy alias and a single HIP component.

names.name: Tureis
names.reason: Name conflict is substantive: IAU Tureis means Rho Puppis, whereas older astrological lists also applied Tureis to Iota Carinae (Aspidiske). Cannot choose merely by matching the IAU proper name.
